w:r.w:t: SubStation Equipment and Asset Condition Monitoring System

This document covers end-to-end UI test cases for the multi-session testing workflow in SEACMS. Test cases are grouped by module and role. Each case includes test steps, expected results, and a status field for manual execution tracking.
